audience: developers and DevOps teams who run services, jobs and databases on Northflank

useCases.title: List our projects and services and see which are paused
useCases.text: Lists your projects, then the services in a project with their build and deployment status, and reads one service in detail.

useCases.title: Check the CPU and memory use of a service
useCases.text: Reads CPU and memory metrics of a service's containers, either a current snapshot or a time range.

useCases.title: Review the build history of a service
useCases.text: Lists the build runs of a build service with branch, commit sha, status and timestamps, so you can find failed or slow builds.

useCases.title: Check jobs, addons and custom domains
useCases.text: Lists jobs with their cron schedule, addons (managed databases and services) with their status, and custom domains with their verification status.

useCases.title: Start a build for a service
useCases.text: Starts a new build of a build service. By default it builds the latest commit of the linked branch, or you can name a branch, commit sha or pull request.

useCases.title: Scale, restart, pause or resume a service
useCases.text: Sets the number of running instances of a service, restarts its containers, pauses it to zero instances, or resumes a paused one.
